summary: Software developer with 15 years of self-taught web application work, 4+ years in React and React Native, and 2.5 years of production C# experience building Revit automation plugins. Lead developer of a live subscription audio platform and volunteer sysadmin for a community technology co-op. Background in 3D modeling (Blender, 3D Studio Max, SketchUp) and CAD (AutoCAD, Revit) informs approach to translating design workflows into technical solutions. Developed plugins used daily by 12+ drafters, reducing dimensioning tasks from minutes to milliseconds. Maintains 296 public GitHub repositories across two accounts, including an open-source full stack template with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility checks and 6,400+ passing automated tests. Seeking full stack or accessibility-minded web development roles where I can build tools that solve real problems for the people who use them.
